speak: The African diaspora sends hundreds of billions of dollars home every year. A transfer moves the money. It does not control what the money is used for.
caption: The African diaspora sends hundreds of billions of dollars home every year. A transfer moves the money. It does not control what the money is used for.

speak: Nob Pay holds that money in escrow, and releases it step by step, only when the work is shown. Anyone can verify the record.
caption: NobPay holds that money in escrow, and releases it step by step, only when the work is shown. Anyone can verify the record.

speak: This is the live demo. Payments here are simulated. We sign in with the demo account.
caption: This is the live demo. Payments here are simulated. We sign in with the demo account.

speak: A funder follows a project back home. One proof is waiting for her decision, and nothing is paid without her approval.
caption: A funder follows a project back home. One proof is waiting for her decision, and nothing is paid without her approval.

speak: Money enters escrow through a Lightning invoice. In this demo it cannot be paid, so we simulate the payment.
caption: Money enters escrow through a Lightning invoice. In this demo it cannot be paid, so we simulate the payment.

speak: Here is the proof the person on site sent: geotagged photos, an invoice, and the supplier to pay. The funder looks, then decides.
caption: Here is the proof the person on site sent: geotagged photos, an invoice, and the supplier to pay. The funder looks, then decides.

speak: Before paying, she sees the quote: what is debited, the rate, the fees, and what the supplier receives. She confirms, and the supplier is paid directly, by mobile money.
caption: Before paying, she sees the quote: what is debited, the rate, the fees, and what the supplier receives. She confirms, and the supplier is paid directly, by mobile money.

speak: Then the next step opens. The person on site needs no account: a private link, a photo that the phone dates and locates, the invoice, and who should be paid.
caption: Then the next step opens. The person on site needs no account: a private link, a photo that the phone dates and locates, the invoice, and who should be paid.

speak: The funder is notified, and decides.
caption: The funder is notified, and decides.

speak: Every event joins a hash chained ledger. Change one line, and everything after it breaks. We anchor its fingerprint on Bitcoin, with Open Timestamps.
caption: Every event joins a hash-chained ledger. Change one line, and everything after it breaks. We anchor its fingerprint on Bitcoin, with OpenTimestamps.

speak: And a public page lets anyone check the file, without an account. The browser redoes the calculations itself. Nobody has to trust our server.
caption: And a public page lets anyone check the file, without an account. The browser redoes the calculations itself. Nobody has to trust our server.

speak: What is real: the ledger, the Bitcoin anchoring, and the verification. The Lightning path is tested against a wallet simulator, not yet with real sats, and Nos ter publishing is off on this free demo.
caption: What is real: the ledger, the Bitcoin anchoring, and the verification. The Lightning path is tested against a wallet simulator, not yet with real sats, and Nostr publishing is off on this free demo.
